latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Comic Panel Generator.

- Generate AI comic panels, manga strips, and graphic novel art from text using the Neta API.
- Supports anime-style, webcomic frames, storyboards, and manga-style sequential art.
- Options for output size and style inheritance via reference images.
- Requires a free Neta API token.
